parameters: Two common multipliers of existing rho_crit and metanet_a_m; physical_cell_fd in existing harness.

caveat: rho_crit also enters existing lane-drop denominator; preserve this equation consistency, do not claim pure FD effect or hard-capacity bonus. Shape>1 for all trial cells.
scope: East31 plus8connectors, not wholeOmega. No future observed data as prediction inputs.
